query:
SELECT (
               SELECT h.sha FROM git_sync_synced_head h
               WHERE h.workspace_id = $1 AND h.repo_resource_path = $4 AND h.branch = $3
               ORDER BY h.synced_at DESC LIMIT 1
           ) = $2 AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM v2_job_queue q
               JOIN v2_job j ON j.id = q.id
               WHERE q.workspace_id = $1
                 AND j.kind IN ('dependencies', 'flowdependencies', 'appdependencies')
           ) as "ready"
